title: Daily NetFlow Traffic Report
description: Generated by grafana-report. Daily report panels: rendered for the previous complete Asia/Riyadh day. Do not edit by hand - regenerate.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS time, sumIf(Bytes * SamplingRate, multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified') = 'inbound') * 8 / 300 AS Inbound, sumIf(Bytes * SamplingRate, multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified') = 'outbound') * 8 / 300 AS Outbound FROM default.flows_5m0s WHERE TimeReceived >= $__fromTime AND TimeReceived < $__toTime AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11') GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS time, sumIf(Bytes * SamplingRate, multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified') IN ('inbound', 'outbound')) * 8 / 300 AS `Report day` FROM default.flows_5m0s WHERE TimeReceived >= $__fromTime AND TimeReceived < $__toTime AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11') GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) + INTERVAL 1 DAY AS time, sumIf(Bytes * SamplingRate, multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified') IN ('inbound', 'outbound')) * 8 / 300 AS `Previous day` FROM default.flows_5m0s WHERE TimeReceived >= $__fromTime - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND TimeReceived < $__toTime - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11') GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS time, sumIf(Bytes * SamplingRate, multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified') = 'inbound') AS Inbound, sumIf(Bytes * SamplingRate, multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified') = 'outbound') AS Outbound FROM default.flows_1h0m0s WHERE TimeReceived >= $__fromTime AND TimeReceived < $__toTime AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11') GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT multiIf(Proto = 6, 'TCP', Proto = 17, 'UDP', Proto = 1, 'ICMP', 'Other') AS Protocol, sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS Bytes FROM default.flows_1h0m0s WHERE TimeReceived >= $__fromTime AND TimeReceived < $__toTime AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11') AND multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified') IN ('inbound', 'outbound') GROUP BY Protocol ORDER BY Bytes DESC

SELECT ExporterSite AS Site, sumIf(Bytes * SamplingRate, multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified') = 'inbound') AS InboundBytes, sumIf(Bytes * SamplingRate, multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified') = 'outbound') AS OutboundBytes FROM default.flows_1h0m0s WHERE TimeReceived >= $__fromTime AND TimeReceived < $__toTime AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11') AND ExporterSite != '' GROUP BY Site ORDER BY InboundBytes + OutboundBytes DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT if(InIfBoundary = 'external', InIfProvider, OutIfProvider) AS Provider, sumIf(Bytes * SamplingRate, multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified') = 'inbound') AS InboundBytes, sumIf(Bytes * SamplingRate, multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified') = 'outbound') AS OutboundBytes FROM default.flows_1h0m0s WHERE TimeReceived >= $__fromTime AND TimeReceived < $__toTime AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11') AND multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified') IN ('inbound', 'outbound') AND if(InIfBoundary = 'external', InIfProvider, OutIfProvider) != '' GROUP BY Provider ORDER BY InboundBytes + OutboundBytes DESC LIMIT 10
